delete.summary: Delete a storage location. Materials and items stored there keep existing without a location.

post.summary: Create a material. `trackingType` decides whether it's a bulk or an individual material.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only return materials of this type.

put.summary: Replace a material. Its `trackingType` can't be changed.

409.description: The tracking type differs, the name is taken, or the stock

delete.summary: Delete a material. Only possible while nothing references it (items, purchases, kits, loans).

409.description: The material is still in use.

400.description: Invalid item, or the material isn't an individual one.

parameters.name: materialId
parameters.description: Only return items of this material.

put.summary: Replace an individual item. Its `materialId` can't be changed.

delete.summary:
Delete an individual item. Only possible while it has no damage reports or loans; retire it via its status
otherwise.

409.description: The item is still in use.

post.summary:
Create several individual items at once, e.g. a set of new tents. At most 100; either all of them are
created or none.

400.description: Invalid or no items, or a material isn't an individual one.

409.description: An identifier is taken or used twice.

post.summary: Record a purchase. Its quantity is added to the material's available stock.

400.description: Invalid purchase, or the material isn't a bulk material.

get.summary: Get the purchase history of bulk materials.

parameters.name: materialId
parameters.description: Only return purchases of this material.

put.summary: Replace a purchase. Its `materialId` can't be changed. The stock changes by the difference of the quantities.

409.description: The stock would drop below the pieces lent out.

delete.summary: Delete a purchase. Its quantity is subtracted from the stock again.

409.description: The stock would drop below the pieces lent out.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Only return reports for this individual item.

put.summary: Replace a damage report, e.g. to resolve it. Its `itemId` can't be changed.
Replace a kit including all of its groups.

400.description: Invalid loan or unknown item or material.

409.description: Something isn't available (inactive, lent out, out of stock).

parameters.name: open
parameters.description: If set, only open (true) or only returned (false) loans.

put.summary: Replace a loan including its items. Set `returnedAt` to mark it as returned.

409.description: Same as for creating a loan.
